segs.en: According to Kabbalah, do not sanctify the moon until after 7 days from the molad. Sanctify the moon in fine garments. Before the blessing, say:
segs.text: <small>על פי הקבלה אין לקדש הלבנה עד אחר ז׳ ימים למולד. ויש לקדש הלבנה בבגדים חשובים ונאים וקודם הברכה יאמר:</small>

הַלְלוּיָהּ הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְיָ מִן הַשָּׁמַֽיִם הַלְלֽוּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִים: הַלְלֽוּהוּ כָל־מַלְאָכָיו הַלְלֽוּהוּ כָּל־צְבָאָיו: הַלְלֽוּהוּ שֶֽׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵֽחַ הַלְלֽוּהוּ כָּל־כּֽוֹכְבֵי אוֹר: הַלְלֽוּהוּ שְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמָֽיִם וְהַמַּֽיִם אֲשֶׁר מֵעַל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְיָ כִּי הוּא צִוָּה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ: וַיַּעֲמִידֵם לָעַד לְעוֹלָם חָק־נָתַן וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר:

segs.en: Straighten your feet and look at the moon once before the blessing; when you begin the blessing, do not look at it at all.
segs.text: <small>יאשר רגליו ויביט בלבנה פעם אחת קודם הברכה וכשיתחיל לברך לא יראה בה כלל:</small>

בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר בְּמַאֲמָרוֹ בָּרָא שְׁחָקִים, וּבְרֽוּחַ פִּיו כָּל־צְבָאָם, חֹק וּזְמַן נָתַן לָהֶם שֶׁלֹּא יְשַׁנּוּ אֶת־תַּפְקִידָם, שָׂשִׂים וּשְׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹן קוֹנָם, פּוֹעֵל אֱמֶת שֶׁפְּעֻלָּתוֹ אֱמֶת, וְלַלְּבָנָה אָמַר, שֶׁתִּתְחַדֵּשׁ עֲטֶֽרֶת תִּפְאֶֽרֶת לַעֲמֽוּסֵי בָֽטֶן, שֶׁהֵם עֲתִידִים לְהִתְחַדֵּשׁ כְּמוֹתָהּ וּלְפָאֵר לְיוֹצְרָם עַל שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְחַדֵּשׁ חֳדָשִׁים:

segs.en: Jump three jumps and say:
segs.text: <small>ידלג שלשה דילוגים ויאמר:</small>

בָּרוּךְ עוֹשֵׂךְ, בָּרוּךְ יוֹצְרֵךְ, בָּרוּךְ בּוֹרְאֵךְ, בָּרוּךְ קוֹנֵךְ: כְּשֵׁם שֶׁאֲנִי רוֹקֵד כְּנֶגְדֵּךְ וְאֵינִי יָכוֹל לִנְגֽוֹעַ בָּךְ, כַּךְ לֹא יוּכְלוּ כָּל־אוֹיְבַי לִנְגֽוֹעַ בִּי לְרָעָה: תִּפֹּל עֲלֵיהֶם אֵימָֽתָה וָפַֽחַד, בִּגְדֹל זְרוֹעֲךָ יִדְּמוּ כָּאָֽבֶן: כָּאָֽבֶן יִדְּמוּ זְרוֹעֲךָ בִּגְדֹל וָפַֽחַד אֵימָֽתָה עֲלֵיהֶם תִּפֹּל:

segs.en: Do this three times: jump three jumps and say from 'Boruch Oshecha' to here.
segs.text: <small>ככה יעשה ג׳ פעמים ידלג ג׳ דילוגים ואומר מבורך עושך וכו׳ עד כאן.</small>

parts.text: סִמָּן טוֹב וּמַזָּל טוֹב יִהְיֶה לָֽנוּ וּלְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל. אָמֵן:

segs.text: קוֹל דּוֹדִי הִנֵּה־זֶה בָּא, מְדַלֵּג עַל־הֶהָרִים, מְקַפֵּץ עַל־הַגְּבָעוֹת: דּוֹמֶה דוֹדִי לִצְבִי אוֹ לְעֹֽפֶר הָאַיָּלִים, הִנֵּה־זֶה עוֹמֵד אַחַר כָּתְלֵֽנוּ, מַשְׁגִּֽיחַ מִן־הַחַלּוֹנוֹת, מֵצִיץ מִן־הַחֲרַכִּים:

שִׁיר לַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִים מֵאַֽיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי: עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְיָ עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַֽיִם וָאָֽרֶץ: אַל־יִתֵּן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֶֽךָ אַל־יָנוּם שֹׁמְרֶֽךָ: הִנֵּה לֹא־יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל: יְיָ שֹׁמְרֶֽךָ יְיָ צִלְּךָ עַל־יַד יְמִינֶֽךָ: יוֹמָם הַשֶּֽׁמֶשׁ לֹא־יַכֶּֽכָּה וְיָרֵֽחַ בַּלָּֽיְלָה: יְיָ יִשְׁמָרְךָ מִכָּל־רָע יִשְׁמֹר אֶת־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ: יְיָ יִשְׁמָר צֵאתְךָ וּבוֹאֶֽךָ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם:

הַלְלוּיָהּ הַֽלְלוּ־אֵל בְּקָדְשׁוֹ הַלְלֽוּהוּ בִּרְקִֽיעַ עֻזּוֹ: הַלְלֽוּהוּ בִּגְבוּרֹתָיו הַלְלֽוּהוּ כְּרֹב גֻּדְלוֹ: הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּתֵֽקַע שׁוֹפָר הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּנֵֽבֶל וְכִנּוֹר: הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּתֹף וּמָחוֹל הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעֻגָב: הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְצִלְצְלֵי־שָֽׁמַע הַלְלֽוּהוּ בְּצִלְצְלֵי תְרוּעָה: כֹּל הַנְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּל יָהּ הַלְלוּיָהּ: כֹּל הַנְּשָׁמָה תְּהַלֵּל יָהּ הַלְלוּיָהּ:

תָּנָא דְבֵי רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל: אִלְמָלֵי לֹא זָכוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶלָּא לְהַקְבִּיל פְּנֵי אֲבִיהֶם שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַֽיִם פַּֽעַם אַחַת בַּחֹֽדֶשׁ, דַּיָּם. אָמַר אַבַּיֵּי: הִילְכָךְ נֵימְרִינְהוּ מְעֻמָּד. מִי זֹאת עוֹלָה מִן־הַמִּדְבָּר מִתְרַפֶּֽקֶת עַל־דּוֹדָהּ: וִיהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי, לְמַלְּאוֹת פְּגִימַת הַלְּבָנָה, וְלֹא יִהְיֶה בָהּ שׁוּם מִעוּט, וְיִהְיֶה אוֹר־הַלְּבָנָה כְּאוֹר הַחַמָּה כְּאוֹר שִׁבְעַת יְמֵי בְרֵאשִׁית, כְּמוֹ שֶׁהָיְתָה קֹֽדֶם מִעוּטָהּ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַיַּעַשׂ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־שְׁנֵי הַמְּאֹרוֹת הַגְּדֹלִים. וְיִתְקַיֵּם בָּֽנוּ מִקְרָא שֶׁכָּתוּב: וּבִקְשׁוּ אֶת־יְיָ אֱלֹהֵיהֶם וְאֵת דָּוִיד מַלְכָּם. אָמֵן:

לַמְנַצֵּֽחַ בִּנְגִינוֹת מִזְמוֹר שִׁיר: אֱלֹהִים יְחָנֵּֽנוּ וִיבָרְכֵֽנוּ יָאֵר פָּנָיו אִתָּֽנוּ סֶֽלָה: לָדַֽעַת בָּאָֽרֶץ דַּרְכֶּֽךָ בְּכָל־גּוֹיִם יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ: יוֹדֽוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדֽוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם: יִשְׂמְחוּ וִירַנְּנוּ לְאֻמִּים כִּי־תִשְׁפּוֹט עַמִּים מִישׁוֹר וּלְאֻמִּים בָּאָֽרֶץ תַּנְחֵם סֶֽלָה: יוֹדֽוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדֽוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם: אֶֽרֶץ נָתְנָה יְבוּלָהּ יְבָרְכֵֽנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ: יְבָרְכֵֽנוּ אֱלֹהִים וְיִירְאוּ אוֹתוֹ כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ:

parts.text: עָלֵֽינוּ לְשַׁבֵּֽחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל, לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית, שֶׁלֺּא עָשָֽׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת, וְלֺא שָׂמָֽנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה, שֶׁלֺּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵֽנוּ כָּהֶם, וְגוֹרָלֵֽנוּ כְּכָל־הֲמוֹנָם, שֶׁהֵם מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לְהֶֽבֶל וְלָרִיק:

לִפְנֵי מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ, בָּרוּךְ הוּא: שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַֽיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָֽרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל, וּשְׁכִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְהֵי מְרוֹמִים, הוּא אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּֽנוּ, אֶֽפֶס זוּלָתוֹ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ: וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל־לְבָבֶֽךָ, כִּי יְיָ הוּא הָאֱלֺהִים בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל, וְעַל־הָאָֽרֶץ מִתָּֽחַת, אֵין עוֹד:

segs.text: וְעַל־כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ, לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶֽרֶת עֻזֶּֽךָ, לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן הָאָֽרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן, לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי: וְכָל־בְּנֵי־בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁמֶֽךָ, לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶֽיךָ כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי אָֽרֶץ. יַכִּֽירוּ וְיֵדְעוּ כָּל־יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל, כִּי־לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל־בֶּֽרֶךְ, תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל־לָשׁוֹן: לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְיָ אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפּֽוֹלוּ, וְלִכְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּֽנוּ, וִיקַבְּלוּ כֻלָּם עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־עוֹל מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ, וְתִמְלוֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּךָ הִיא, וּלְעֽוֹלְמֵי עַד תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ: יְיָ יִמְלֺךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד. וְנֶאֱמַר: וְהָיָה יְיָ לְמֶֽלֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ, בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְיָ אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:

segs.en: Mourner's Kaddish
segs.text: קדיש יתום

parts.text: בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא.

segs.text: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּֽא מִן־שְׁמַיָּֽא וְחַיִּֽים טוֹבִֽים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו הוּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה שָׁלֽוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן:

segs.text: אַל־תִּירָא מִפַּחַד פִּתאֹם, וּמִשֹׁאַת רְשָׁעִים כִּי תָבֹא: עֻֽצוּ עֵצָה וְתֻפָר, דַּבְּרוּ דָבָר וְלֹא יָקוּם כִּי עִמָּנוּ אֵל: וְעַד זִקְנָה אֲנִי הוּא, וְעַד שֵׂיבָה אֲנִי אֶסְבֹּל: אֲנִי עָשִֽׂיתִי וַאֲנִי אֶשָׂא וַאֲנִי אֶסְבֹּל וַאֲמַלֵּט: אַךְ צַדִּיקִים יוֹדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ יֵשְׁבוּ יְשָׁרִים אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ׃

segs.en: And shake the fringes of the tallit katan.
segs.text: <small>וינער שולי טלית קטן:</small>

Praise Hashem! Praise Hashem from the heavens; praise Him in the heights. Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts. Praise Him, sun and moon; praise Him, all you stars of light. Praise Him, you highest heavens, and you waters above the heavens. Let them praise the name of Hashem, for He commanded and they were created. He established them forever and ever; He gave a decree and it shall not pass away.

Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who by His word created the heavens, and by the breath of His mouth all their hosts. He gave them a law and a time, that they should not change their appointed task. They are glad and rejoice to do the will of their Owner, a Worker of truth whose work is truth. And to the moon He said that it should renew itself, a crown of splendor for those who are borne from the womb, who in time to come will be renewed like it, and will glorify their Creator for the sake of the glory of His kingdom. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who renews the months.

Blessed is your Maker, blessed is your Former, blessed is your Creator, blessed is your Owner. Just as I dance toward you but cannot touch you, so may none of my enemies be able to touch me for harm. May fear and dread fall upon them; at the greatness of Your arm may they be still as a stone. As a stone may they be still; at the greatness of Your arm; may fear and dread fall upon them.
David, King of Israel, lives and endures.
Peace be upon you. Upon you be peace.
A good sign and good fortune be ours and for all Israel. Amen.

The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping over the mountains, skipping over the hills. My beloved is like a gazelle or a young deer. Behold, he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, peering through the lattices.

A song of ascents. I lift my eyes to the mountains: from where will my help come? My help comes from Hashem, Maker of heaven and earth. He will not let your foot slip; your Guardian will not slumber. Behold, the Guardian of Israel neither slumbers nor sleeps. Hashem is your Guardian; Hashem is your shade at your right hand. By day the sun will not strike you, nor the moon by night. Hashem will guard you from all evil; He will guard your soul. Hashem will guard your going out and your coming in, from now and forever.

Praise Hashem! Praise God in His sanctuary; praise Him in the firmament of His power. Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him according to His abundant greatness. Praise Him with the blast of the shofar; praise Him with harp and lyre. Praise Him with drum and dance; praise Him with strings and flute. Praise Him with resounding cymbals; praise Him with clanging cymbals. Let every soul praise Yah. Praise Hashem! Let every soul praise Yah. Praise Hashem!

It was taught in the school of Rabbi Yishmael: Had Israel merited only to greet the presence of their Father in heaven once a month, it would be enough for them. Abaye said: Therefore we should say it standing. “Who is this coming up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved?” May it be Your will, Hashem my God and God of my fathers, to fill the flaw of the moon, so that there be no diminishing in it; and may the light of the moon be like the light of the sun and like the light of the seven days of Creation, as it was before it was diminished, as it is said: “And God made the two great lights.” And may the verse that is written be fulfilled in us:

For the conductor, with stringed instruments; a psalm, a song. May God be gracious to us and bless us; may He make His face shine upon us, Selah. That Your way may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations. Peoples will thank You, O God; all peoples will thank You. Nations will be glad and sing for joy, for You judge peoples with fairness and guide the nations on earth, Selah. Peoples will thank You, O God; all peoples will thank You. The earth has yielded its produce; God, our God, will bless us. God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth will fear Him.

It is our duty to praise the Master of all, to ascribe greatness to the Creator of the beginning, who has not made us like the nations of the lands, nor placed us like the families of the earth; who has not set our portion as theirs, nor our lot as all their multitude, for they bow down to vanity and emptiness. But we bend the knee, bow down and give thanks before the King, King of kings, the Holy One, blessed is He, who stretches out the heavens and founds the earth, whose seat of glory is in the heavens above and the abode of His mighty Presence is in the loftiest heights. He is our God; there is no other. Truly He is our King; there is nothing besides Him, as it is written in His Torah: “Know this day and take to heart that Hashem is God in the heavens above and on the earth below; there is no other.”

Therefore we hope to You, Hashem our God, soon to see the glory of Your might, to remove abominations from the earth and to have idols utterly cut off, to perfect the world under the kingdom of the Almighty. All humankind will call on Your name, to turn to You all the wicked of the earth. All the inhabitants of the world will recognize and know that to You every knee must bow and every tongue swear. Before You, Hashem our God, they will kneel and fall, and to Your glorious name give honor; and all will accept the yoke of Your kingdom, and You will reign over them soon and forever. For the kingdom is Yours, and to all eternity You will reign in glory, as it is written in Your Torah: “Hashem will reign forever and ever.” And it is said: “Hashem will be King over all the earth; on that day Hashem will be One and His name One.”

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
May there be abundant peace from heaven, and good life, for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.

parts.text: in His heights, may He make peace for us and for all Israel, and say: Amen.

segs.text: Do not fear sudden terror, nor the destruction of the wicked when it comes. Devise a plan and it will be foiled; speak a word and it will not stand, for God is with us. Even to old age I am the same, and even to gray hairs I will carry you; I have made you and I will bear you, and I will carry and rescue. Surely the righteous will thank Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.

segs.en: Take the lulav with the species. The three species of lulav (lulav, hadas, and arava) must be tied and bound together, with no string or adhesive separating them. When taking them, the spine of the lulav should face you; hold three hadasim (one on the right, one on the left, one in the middle leaning slightly right) and two aravot (one on the right, one on the left).
segs.text: <small>לולב עם המינים. ג׳ מיני לולב דהיינו לולב והדס וערבה יהיו קשורים ואגודים יחד ולא יהיה חוט או משיחה חוצץ ביניהם ובשעת נטילה יהיה שדרת הלולב נגד פניו ויהיו ג׳ הדסים א׳ בימינו וא׳ בשמאלו וא׳ באמצע השדרה נוטה קצת לימין ושני בדי ערבות א׳ לימין וא׳ לשמאל:</small>

segs.en: Halachically, one should bless on the lulav after the Amidah and before Hallel. However, since the mitzvah is best performed in the sukkah, and one cannot leave the synagogue due to onlookers, the blessing is made in the morning before the Amidah while still in the sukkah.
segs.text: <small>ומן הדין יש לברך על הלולב אחר התפלה קודם ההלל אלא לפי שמצות נטילתו בסוכה הוא מצוה מן המובחר ואי אפשר לצאת מבית הכנסת מפני הרואים לפיכך בבוקר קודם שיתפלל בעודו בסוכה יברך:</small>

segs.en: First take the lulav alone in the right hand and make the blessing. Then take the etrog in the left hand. At the point where the text says 'lulav, hadas, and arava', join the etrog with the lulav and shake in the six directions (Hei-Yud). For each direction, make three movements out and three movements in (three times out and in). On each 'in' movement, touch the end of the lulav and its species and the etrog to your chest. When shaking, ensure the top of the lulav does not touch the wall; leave space.
segs.text: <small>ויקח הלולב תחלה לבדו בימינו ויברך ואח״כ יקח האתרוג בשמאלו ובמקום סיום הלולב והדס וערבה יחבר האתרוג עם הלולב וינענע לששה קצוות ח״י נענועים שבכל צד שינענע יעשה ג׳ הולכות וג׳ הובאות דהיינו הולכה והובאה ג׳ פעמים ובכל הובאה יגע סוף הלולב ומיניו והאתרוג לחזה שלו ממש. וכשינענע יזהר שלא יגע ראש הלולב בכותל רק שיהיה חלל בינתיים:</small>

segs.en: The order of shaking: 1) South, 2) North, 3) East, 4) Up, 5) Down (do not invert the lulav; the 'out' movement is downward and the 'in' movement is upward, opposite of the 'up' direction), 6) West. (In all movements, the top of the lulav points upward, but the 'out' movement is toward the direction being shaken).
segs.text: <small>סדר הנענועים הראשון לדרום השני לצפון הג׳ למזרח הרביעי למעלה החמישי למטה ולא שיהפך ח״ו ראש הלולב למטה אלא שההולכה תהיה לצד מטה וההובאה לצד מעלה הפך מלמעלה (וכן בכל הנענועים יהיה ראש הלולב לצד מעלה אלא שהולכה תהיה לאותו צד שמנענע) הששי למערב:</small>

segs.en: During Hallel, perform the six-direction shaking four times: once at the beginning of Hodu, once at Ana HaShem Haoshi'a Na, once at the repetition of Ana HaShem Haoshi'a Na, and once at the end of Hodu.
segs.text: <small>ובהלל יעשה ד׳ פעמים ח״י נענועים דהיינו פעם אחת בהודו לה׳ שבתחילה ואחד באנא ה׳ הושיעה נא ואחד בכופלו אנא ה׳ הושיעה נא ואחד בהודו לבסוף:</small>

segs.en: If one blessed on the lulav after the Amidah in the synagogue, shake only three times during Hallel: at the beginning and end of Hodu, and once at Ana (as stated in the Rama).
segs.text: <small>ואם בירך על הלולב אחר התפלה בבית הכנסת לא ינענע בהלל אלא ג׳ פעמים דהיינו בהודו תחלה וסוף ובאנא פעם אחת (כמ״ש בר״מ):</small>
בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ אֱלהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָֽם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָֽיו, וְצִוָּֽנוּ עַל נְטִילַֽת לוּלָֽב:

segs.en: On the first time one blesses on the lulav, also recite Shehecheyanu.
segs.text: <small>בפעם הראשונה שמברך על הלולב מברך גם שהחיינו:</small>
בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ אֱלהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָֽם, שֶׁהֶחֱיָֽנוּ וְקִיְּמָֽנוּ וְהִגִּיעָֽנוּ לִזְמַֽן הַזֶּֽה:
Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who has sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us concerning the taking of the lulav.
Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who has kept us alive, sustained us, and brought us to this time.

segs.en: These are the days when Hallel is recited in full: the first two days and nights of Pesach, the two days of Shavuot, the nine days of Sukkot, and the eight days of Chanukah. On days when Hallel is not recited in full, the custom is that the chazzan recites the blessings at the beginning and end, and the congregation answers Amen, thereby fulfilling the obligation through his blessing.
segs.text: <small>אלו ימים שגומרים בהם את ההלל ב׳ ימים וב׳ לילות ראשונים של פסח. ב׳ ימים דשבועות. ט׳ ימים דסוכות. ח׳ ימים דחנוכה. ובימים שאין גומרים את ההלל יש לנהוג שהש״ץ לבדו יברך בתחלה ובסוף והקהל יענו אמן ויצא בברכתו:</small>
בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ אֱלהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָֽם, אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָֽיו, וְצִוָּֽנוּ לִקְרֽוֹא אֶת־הַהַלֵּֽל:

הַלְלוּיָהּ הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְיָ הַלְלוּ אֶת שֵׁם יְיָ: יְהִי שֵׁם יְיָ מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם: מִמִּזְרַח־שֶֽׁמֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹאוֹ מְהֻלָּל שֵׁם יְיָ: רָם עַל־כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְיָ עַל הַשָּׁמַֽיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ: מִי כַּייָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ הַמַּגְבִּיהִי לָשָֽׁבֶת: הַמַּשְׁפִּילִי לִרְאוֹת בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ: מְקִימִי מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן: לְהוֹשִׁיבִי עִם־נְדִיבִים עִם נְדִיבֵי עַמּוֹ: מוֹשִׁיבִי עֲקֶֽרֶת הַבַּֽיִת אֵם־הַבָּנִים שְׂמֵחָה הַלְלוּיָהּ:

בְּצֵאת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָֽיִם בֵּית יַעֲקֹב מֵעַם לֹעֵז: הָיְתָה יְהוּדָה לְקָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָיו: הַיָּם רָאָה וַיָּנֹס הַיַּרְדֵּן יִסֹּב לְאָחוֹר: הֶהָרִים רָקְדוּ כְאֵילִים גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹאן: מַה־לְּךָ הַיָּם כִּי תָנוּס הַיַּרְדֵּן תִּסֹּב לְאָחוֹר: הֶהָרִים תִּרְקְדוּ כְאֵילִים גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹאן: מִלִּפְנֵי אָדוֹן חֽוּלִי אָֽרֶץ מִלִּפְנֵי אֱלֽוֹהַּ יַעֲקֹב: הַהֹפְכִי הַצּוּר אֲגַם־מָֽיִם חַלָּמִישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ־מָֽיִם:

segs.en: On Rosh Chodesh and Chol HaMoed Pesach, skip the following psalm.
segs.text: <small>בראש חודש ובחוה״מ פסח מדלגין:</small>

לֹא לָֽנוּ יְיָ לֹא לָֽנוּ כִּי לְשִׁמְךָ תֵּן כָּבוֹד עַל־חַסְדְּךָ עַל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ: לָֽמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה־נָא אֱלֹהֵיהֶם: וֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ בַשָּׁמָֽיִם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵץ עָשָׂה: עֲצַבֵּיהֶם כֶּֽסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּֽרוּ עֵינַֽיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ: אָזְנַֽיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִשְׁמָֽעוּ אַף לָהֶם וְלֹא יְרִיחוּן: יְדֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְמִישׁוּן רַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְהַלֵּֽכוּ לֹא־יֶהְגּוּ בִּגְרוֹנָם: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵֽחַ בָּהֶם: יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּטַח בַּייָ עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא: בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בִּטְחוּ בַייָ עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא: יִרְאֵי יְיָ בִּטְחוּ בַייָ עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא:

יְיָ זְכָרָֽנוּ יְבָרֵךְ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית אַהֲרֹן: יְבָרֵךְ יִרְאֵי יְיָ הַקְּטַנִּים עִם־הַגְּדֹלִים: יֹסֵף יְיָ עֲלֵיכֶם עֲלֵיכֶם וְעַל־בְּנֵיכֶם: בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַייָ עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַֽיִם וָאָֽרֶץ: הַשָּׁמַֽיִם שָׁמַֽיִם לַייָ וְהָאָֽרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי־אָדָם: לֹא־הַמֵּתִים יְהַלְלוּ־יָהּ וְלֹא כָּל־יֹרְדֵי דוּמָה: וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְלוּיָהּ:

segs.en: On Rosh Chodesh and Chol HaMoed Pesach, skip the following psalm.
segs.text: <small>בראש חודש ובחוה״מ פסח מדלגין:</small>

אָהַֽבְתִּי כִּי־יִשְׁמַע יְיָ אֶת־קוֹלִי תַּחֲנוּנָי: כִּי־הִטָּה אָזְנוֹ לִי וּבְיָמַי אֶקְרָא: אֲפָפֽוּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָֽוֶת וּמְצָרֵי שְׁאוֹל מְצָאֽוּנִי צָרָה וְיָגוֹן אֶמְצָא: וּבְשֵׁם־יְיָ אֶקְרָא אָנָּה יְיָ מַלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי: חַנּוּן יְיָ וְצַדִּיק וֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ מְרַחֵם: שֹׁמֵר פְּתָאיִם יְיָ דַּלּוֹתִי וְלִי יְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ: שׁוּבִי נַפְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָֽיְכִי כִּי־יְיָ גָּמַל עָלָֽיְכִי: כִּי חִלַּֽצְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּֽוֶת אֶת־עֵינִי מִן־דִּמְעָה אֶת־רַגְלִי מִדֶּֽחִי: אֶתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי יְיָ בְּאַרְצוֹת הַחַיִּים: הֶאֱמַֽנְתִּי כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אֲנִי עָנִֽיתִי מְאֹד: אֲנִי אָמַֽרְתִּי בְחָפְזִי כָּל־הָאָדָם כֹּזֵב:

מָה־אָשִׁיב לַייָ כָּל־תַּגְמוּלֽוֹהִי עָלָי: כּוֹס־יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וּבְשֵׁם יְיָ אֶקְרָא: נְדָרַי לַייָ אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה־נָּא לְכָל־עַמּוֹ: יָקָר בְּעֵינֵי יְיָ הַמָּֽוְתָה לַחֲסִידָיו: אָנָּה יְיָ כִּי־אֲנִי עַבְדֶּֽךָ אֲנִי־עַבְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶֽךָ פִּתַּֽחְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָי: לְךָ־אֶזְבַּח זֶֽבַח תּוֹדָה וּבְשֵׁם יְיָ אֶקְרָא: נְדָרַי לַייָ אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגְדָה־נָּא לְכָל־עַמּוֹ: בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְיָ בְּתוֹכֵֽכִי יְרוּשָׁלָֽםִ הַלְלוּיָהּ:
הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְיָ כָּל־גּוֹיִם שַׁבְּחֽוּהוּ כָּל־הָאֻמִּים: כִּי גָּבַר עָלֵֽינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְיָ לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּיָהּ:

parts.text: הוֹדוּ לַייָ כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
הוֹדוּ לַייָ כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
הוֹדוּ לַייָ כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
הוֹדוּ לַייָ כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
יֹֽאמְרוּ־נָא יִרְאֵי יְיָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
הוֹדוּ לַייָ כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:

מִן־הַמֵּצַר קָרָֽאתִי יָהּ עָנָֽנִי בַמֶּרְחָב יָהּ: יְיָ לִי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה לִי אָדָם: יְיָ לִי בְּעֹזְרָי וַאֲנִי אֶרְאֶה בְשׂנְאָי: טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּייָ מִבְּטֹֽחַ בָּאָדָם: טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּייָ מִבְּטֹֽחַ בִּנְדִיבִים: כָּל־גּוֹיִם סְבָבֽוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְיָ כִּי אֲמִילַם: סַבּֽוּנִי גַם־סְבָבֽוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְיָ כִּי אֲמִילַם: סַבּֽוּנִי כִדְבֹרִים דֹּעֲכוּ כְּאֵשׁ קוֹצִים בְּשֵׁם יְיָ כִּי אֲמִילַם: דָּחֹה דְחִיתַֽנִי לִנְפֹּל וַייָ עֲזָרָֽנִי: עָזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ וַיְהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה: קוֹל רִנָּה וִישׁוּעָה בְּאָהֳלֵי צַדִּיקִים יְמִין יְיָ עֹֽשָׂה חָֽיִל: יְמִין יְיָ רוֹמֵמָה יְמִין יְיָ עֹֽשָׂה חָֽיִל: לֹא־אָמוּת כִּי־אֶחְיֶה וַאֲסַפֵּר מַעֲשֵׂי יָהּ: יַסֹּר יִסְּרַֽנִּי יָהּ וְלַמָּֽוֶת לֹא נְתָנָֽנִי: פִּתְחוּ־לִי שַֽׁעֲרֵי־צֶֽדֶק אָֽבֹא־בָם אוֹדֶה יָהּ: זֶה־הַשַּֽׁעַר לַייָ צַדִּיקִים יָבֹֽאוּ בוֹ: אוֹדְךָ כִּי עֲנִיתָֽנִי וַתְּהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה:
אֶֽבֶן מָאֲסוּ הַבּוֹנִים הָיְתָה לְרֹאשׁ פִּנָּה:
מֵאֵת יְיָ הָֽיְתָה זֹּאת הִיא נִפְלָאת בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ:
זֶה־הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְיָ נָגִֽילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ:

segs.text: אָֽנָּא יְיָ הוֹשִֽׁיעָה נָּא:
אָֽנָּא יְיָ הוֹשִֽׁיעָה נָּא:
אָֽנָּא יְיָ הַצְלִיחָה נָא:
אָֽנָּא יְיָ הַצְלִיחָה נָא:

parts.text: בָּרוּךְ הַבָּא בְּשֵׁם יְיָ בֵּרַכְנוּכֶם מִבֵּית יְיָ:
אֵל יְיָ וַיָּֽאֶר לָֽנוּ אִסְרוּ־חַג בַּעֲבֹתִים עַד־קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ:
הוֹדוּ לַייָ כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ:
וְיַקְדִּֽישׁוּ וְיַמְלִֽיכוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ. כִּי לְךָ טוֹב לְהוֹדוֹת,
כִּי מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד עוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ,

segs.en: Some have the custom to recite this verse after Hallel on Rosh Chodesh.
segs.text: <small>יש נוהגין לומר בר״ח אחר הלל פסוק זה:</small>
וְאַבְרָהָם זָקֵן בָּא בַּיָּמִים וַייָ בֵּרַךְ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם בַּכֹּל:

parts.text: אלהים חיים ומלך עולם אשר בידו נפש כל חי. אמן.

parts.en: All of this is said three times.

segs.en: On Rosh Chodesh, Yom Tov, and Chol HaMoed, recite Kaddish Shalem; on Chanukah, recite Half Kaddish.
segs.text: <small>בראש חדש [אחר אמירת הלל] וביום טוב ובחול המועד קדיש שלם ובחנוכה חצי קדיש:</small>

segs.en: On Rosh Chodesh, Yom Tov, and Chol HaMoed, recite the Psalm of the Day here. On Rosh Chodesh, recite Barchi Nafshi after the Psalm of the Day, followed by Kaddish d'Rabbanan.
segs.text: <small>בראש חדש וביום טוב ובחול המועד אומרים כאן שיר של יום. ובראש חודש אומרים ברכי נפשי אחר שיר של יום קדיש יתום:</small>

segs.en: The Torah is taken out and four men are called up on Rosh Chodesh and Chol HaMoed. Kaddish is recited over the Torah. Then Ashrei and Uva LeTziyon are recited, and the Torah is returned to the Ark. Afterwards, the chazzan recites Half Kaddish, and the Musaf prayer is recited. Tefillin are removed on Rosh Chodesh before the Kaddish. On Chanukah, three men are called up, followed by Kaddish, Ashrei, Uva LeTziyon, and Kaddish Shalem. The Torah is returned to the Ark, and then 'Beit Yaakov' is recited.
segs.text: <small>ומוציאין ספר תורה וקוראין בראש חדש וחול המועד ד׳ גברי. קדיש על ספר תורה. ואח״כ אומרים אשרי ובא לציון ומכניסין ספר תורה להיכל. ואחר כך אומר הש״ץ חצי קדיש ומתפללים תפלת המוסף. ומסירין התפילין בראש חדש קודם הקדיש. ובחנוכה ג׳ גברי וקדיש אשרי ובא לציון קדיש שלם ומכניסין ספר תורה להיכל ואח״כ אומרים בית יעקב:</small>
Thank Hashem, for He is good, for His kindness endures forever.
Thank Hashem, for He is good, for His kindness endures forever.
Let Israel say: for His kindness endures forever.
Thank Hashem, for He is good, for His kindness endures forever.
Let the house of Aaron say: for His kindness endures forever.
Thank Hashem, for He is good, for His kindness endures forever.
Let those who fear Hashem say: for His kindness endures forever.
Thank Hashem, for He is good, for His kindness endures forever.
Blessed are You, Hashem our God, King of the universe, Who has sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us to recite the Hallel.

Praise Hashem! Praise, O servants of Hashem; praise the name of Hashem. May the name of Hashem be blessed from now and forever. From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of Hashem is praised. Hashem is high above all nations; His glory is above the heavens. Who is like Hashem our God, Who sits enthroned so high, Who looks down so low upon heaven and earth? He raises the poor from the dust, He lifts the needy from the refuse heap, to seat him with nobles, with the nobles of His people. He seats the barren woman of the house as a joyful mother of children. Praise Hashem!

When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue, Judah became His sanctuary, Israel His dominion. The sea saw and fled; the Jordan turned back. The mountains skipped like rams, the hills like young sheep. What is the matter with you, O sea, that you flee? O Jordan, that you turn back? O mountains, that you skip like rams? O hills, like young sheep? Before the Master, tremble, O earth, before the God of Jacob, Who turns the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a fountain of water.

Not to us, Hashem, not to us, but to Your name give glory, for the sake of Your kindness and Your truth. Why should the nations say, “Where now is their God?” Our God is in the heavens; all that He wishes, He does. Their idols are silver and gold, the work of human hands. They have a mouth, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see. They have ears, but cannot hear; they have a nose, but cannot smell. Their hands cannot feel; their feet cannot walk; they make no sound in their throat. Those who make them will be like them, all who trust in them. Israel, trust in Hashem! He is their help and their shield. House of Aaron, trust in Hashem! He is their help and their shield. You who fear Hashem, trust in Hashem! He is their help and their shield.

Hashem, Who has remembered us, will bless; He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron. He will bless those who fear Hashem, the small together with the great. May Hashem increase you, you and your children. Blessed are you to Hashem, Maker of heaven and earth. The heavens are the heavens of Hashem, but the earth He has given to humankind. The dead cannot praise Yah, nor any who go down into silence. But we will bless Yah, from now and forever. Praise Hashem!

I love Hashem, for He hears my voice, my supplications. For He has inclined His ear to me, and throughout my days I will call. The bonds of death encircled me, the straits of the grave found me; I found trouble and sorrow. Then I called on the name of Hashem: “Please, Hashem, save my soul!” Hashem is gracious and righteous; our God is merciful. Hashem protects the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me. Return, my soul, to your rest, for Hashem has dealt kindly with you. For You have rescued my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling. I will walk before Hashem in the lands of the living. I kept faith even when I said, “I am greatly afflicted.” I said in my haste, “All men are false.”

How can I repay Hashem for all His bounties to me? I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of Hashem. I will pay my vows to Hashem, in the presence of all His people. Precious in the eyes of Hashem is the death of His devout ones. Please, Hashem, for I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have loosened my bonds. To You I will offer a thanksgiving offering, and I will call on the name of Hashem. I will pay my vows to Hashem, in the presence of all His people, in the courtyards of the House of Hashem, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise Hashem!
Praise Hashem, all nations; extol Him, all peoples. For His kindness has overwhelmed us, and the truth of Hashem is forever. Praise Hashem!

From the straits I called Yah; Yah answered me with relief. Hashem is with me; I will not fear; what can man do to me? Hashem is with me among my helpers, and I will see my desire upon those who hate me. It is better to take refuge in Hashem than to trust in man. It is better to take refuge in Hashem than to trust in nobles. All nations surrounded me; in the name of Hashem I cut them down. They surrounded me, they encircled me; in the name of Hashem I cut them down. They surrounded me like bees; they were extinguished like a fire of thorns; in the name of Hashem I cut them down. You pushed me hard to make me fall, but Hashem helped me. My strength and my song is Yah, and He has become my salvation. The sound of joyful song and salvation is in the tents of the righteous: the right hand of Hashem does valiantly. The right hand of Hashem is raised; the right hand of Hashem does valiantly. I shall not die, but live, and recount the deeds of Yah. Yah has punished me severely, but He did not give me over to death. Open for me the gates of righteousness; I will enter them and thank Yah. This is the gate of Hashem; the righteous shall enter through it. I thank You, for You have answered me and have become my salvation. The stone that the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from Hashem; it is wondrous in our eyes. This is the day that Hashem has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.
Please, Hashem, save us!
Please, Hashem, save us!
Please, Hashem, grant us success!
Please, Hashem, grant us success!

Blessed is he who comes in the name of Hashem; we bless you from the House of Hashem. Hashem is God, and He has given us light; bind the festival offering with cords, up to the horns of the altar. You are my God, and I will thank You; my God, I will exalt You. Thank Hashem, for He is good, for His kindness endures forever.

All Your works shall praise You, Hashem our God, and Your devout ones, the righteous who do Your will, and all Your people, the house of Israel, with joyous song shall thank, bless, praise, glorify, exalt, revere, sanctify, and proclaim the sovereignty of Your name, our King. For it is good to thank You, and it is pleasant to sing praises to Your name, for from the world to the world You are God. Blessed are You, Hashem, King, extolled with praises.
Abraham was old, advanced in years, and Hashem had blessed Abraham with everything.
Zavdiah, may He guard me and keep me alive. So may it be Your will, living God and King of the universe, in Whose hand is the soul of every living being. Amen.

segs.en: The chazzan says Half Kaddish:
segs.text: <small>הש״ץ אומר חצי קדיש:</small>

parts.text: בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא.

segs.text: בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, אֱלֹהֵֽי אַבְרָהָֽם, אֱלֹהֵֽי יִצְחָֽק, וֵאלֹהֵֽי יַעֲקֹֽב, הָאֵֽל הַגָּדֽוֹל הַגִּבּֽוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָֽא, אֵל עֶלְיֽוֹן, גּוֹמֵֽל חֲסָדִֽים טוֹבִֽים, קוֹנֵֽה הַכֹּֽל, וְזוֹכֵֽר חַסְדֵּֽי אָבֽוֹת, וּמֵבִֽיא גּוֹאֵֽל לִבְנֵֽי בְנֵיהֶֽם לְמַֽעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָֽה: מֶֽלֶךְ עוֹזֵֽר וּמוֹשִֽׁיעַ וּמָגֵֽן: בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, מָגֵֽן אַבְרָהָֽם:
אַתָּֽה גִּבּֽוֹר לְעוֹלָֽם אֲדֹנָֽי, מְחַיֶּֽה מֵתִֽים אַתָּֽה, רַב לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ:

מְכַלְכֵּֽל חַיִּֽים בְּחֶֽסֶד, מְחַיֶּֽה מֵתִֽים בְּרַחֲמִֽים רַבִּֽים, סוֹמֵֽךְ נוֹפְלִֽים, וְרוֹפֵֽא חוֹלִֽים, וּמַתִּֽיר אֲסוּרִֽים, וּמְקַיֵּֽם אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ לִישֵׁנֵֽי עָפָֽר. מִי־כָמֽוֹךָ בַּֽעַל גְּבוּרֽוֹת וּמִֽי דּֽוֹמֶה לָּךְ, מֶֽלֶךְ מֵמִֽית וּמְחַיֶּֽה וּמַצְמִֽיחַ יְשׁוּעָֽה: וְנֶאֱמָֽן אַתָּֽה לְהַחֲיוֹֽת מֵתִֽים. בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, מְחַיֶּֽה הַמֵּתִֽים:

parts.en: When the chazzan repeats the Amidah, the congregation says this:

parts.text: כֶּֽתֶר יִתְּנוּ לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מַלְאָכִים הֲמֽוֹנֵי מַֽעְלָה וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל קְבוּצֵי מַֽטָּה. יַחַד כֻּלָּם קְדֻשָּׁה לְךָ יְשַׁלֵּֽשׁוּ, כַּכָּתֽוּב עַל־יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ, וְקָרָֽא זֶה אֶל־זֶֽה וְאָמַֽר:
קָדֽוֹשׁ ׀ קָדֽוֹשׁ, קָדֽוֹשׁ יְיָ צְבָאֽוֹת, מְלֹא כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ:
יִמְלֹֽךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָֽם, אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹֽן לְדֹר וָדֹֽר, הַלְלוּיָֽהּ:

segs.text: אַתָּֽה קָדֽוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָֽ קָדֽוֹשׁ, וּקְדוֹשִֽׁים בְּכָל־יוֹֽם יְהַלְלֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה. בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, הָאֵֽל הַקָּדֽוֹשׁ:

רָאשֵׁי חֳדָשִׁים לְעַמְּךָ נָתַֽתָּ. זְמַן כַּפָּרָה לְכָל־תּוֹלְדוֹתָם: בִּהְיוֹתָם מַקְרִיבִים לְפָנֶֽיךָ זִבְחֵי רָצוֹן, וּשְׂעִירֵי חַטָּאוֹת לְכַפֵּר בַּעֲדָם. זִכָּרוֹן לְכֻלָּם יִהְיֶה, וּתְשׁוּעַת נַפְשָׁם מִיַּד שׂוֹנֵא: מִזְבֵּֽחַ חָדָשׁ בְּצִיּוֹן תָּכִין, וְעוֹלַת רֹאשׁ חֹֽדֶשׁ נַעֲלֶה עָלָיו. וּשְׂעִירֵי עִזִּים נַעֲשֶׂה בְרָצוֹן, וּבַעֲבוֹדַת בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ נִשְׂמַח כֻּלָּֽנוּ. וּבְשִׁירֵי דָּוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ הַנִשְׁמָעִים בְּעִירֶֽךָ הָאֲמוּרִים לִפְנֵי מִזְבְּחֶֽךָ. אַהֲבַת עוֹלָם תָּבִיא לָהֶם. וּבְרִית אָבוֹת לַבָּנִים תִּזְכּוֹר: וַהֲבִיאֵֽנוּ לְצִיוֹן עִירְךָ בְּרִנָּה, וְלִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עולָם, וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֶת־קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ, תְּמִידִים כְּסִדְרָם, וּמוּסָפִים כְּהִלְכָתָם. וְְאֶת־מוּסַף יוֹם רֹאשׁ הַחֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, נַעֲשֶׂה וְנַקְרִיב לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאַהֲבָה, כְּמִצְוַת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַֽבְתָּ עָלֵינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ, עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶֽךָ כָּאָמוּר:
וּבְרָאשֵׁי חָדְשֵׁיכֶם תַּקְרִיבוּ עֹלָה לַייָ, פָּרִים בְּנֵי־בָקָר שְׁנַיִם וְאַֽיִל אֶחָד, כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה שִׁבְעָה, תְּמִימִם:
וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר: שְׁלֹשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר, וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאָֽיִל, וְעִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּֽבֶשׂ, וְיַֽיִן כְּנִסְכּוֹ, וְשָׂעִיר לְכַפֵּר, וּשְׁנֵי תְמִידִים כְּהִלְכָתָם:

אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, חַדֵּשׁ עָלֵינוּ אֶת־הַחֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, לְטוֹבָה וְלִבְרָכָה, לְשָׂשׂוֹן וּלְשִׂמְחָה, לִישׁוּעָה וּלְנֶחָמָה, לְפַרְנָסָה וּלְכַלְכָּלָה, לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם, לִמְחִילַת חֵטְא וְלִסְלִיחַת עָוֹן. כִּי בְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּחַרְתָּ מִכָּל־הָאֻמּוֹת, וְחֻקֵּי רָאשֵׁי חֳדָשִׁים לָהֶם קָבָֽעְתָּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַדֵּשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְרָאשֵׁי חֳדָשִׁים:

רְצֵה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּעַמְּךָֽ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלִתְפִלָּתָֽם שְׁעֵה, וְהָשֵֽׁב הָעֲבוֹדָֽה לִדְבִֽיר בֵּיתֶךָ, וְאִשֵּֽׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָֽם בְּאַהֲבָֽה תְקַבֵּֽל בְּרָצֽוֹן, וּתְהִֽי לְרָצֽוֹן תָּמִֽיד עֲבוֹדַֽת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן:

parts.text: לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, צוּר חַיֵּינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ, אַתָּה־הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר, נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם עִמָּנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־עֵת, עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֱרָיִם. הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹּא־כָלֽוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, הַמְרַחֵֽם, כִּי לֹא־תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ, כִּי מֵעוֹלָֽם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ:

מוֹדִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, אֱלֹהֵי כָּל־בָּשָׂר, יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ, יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית, בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ, עַל שֶׁהֶחֱיִיתָֽנוּ וְקִיַּמְתָּֽנוּ, כֵּן תְּחַיֵּֽינוּ וּתְקַיְּמֵֽנוּ, וְתֶאֱסוֹף גָּלֻיּוֹתֵֽינוּ לְחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ, וְנָשׁוּב אֵלֶיךָ לִשְׁמוֹר חֻקֶּֽיךָ, וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ, וּלְעָבְדְּךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם, עַל שֶׁאָֽנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ, בָּרוּךְ אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת:

parts.en: On Chanukah, say here Al HaNissim:

parts.text: וְעַל הַנִּסִּים וְעַל הַפֻּרְקָן וְעַל הַגְּבוּרוֹת וְעַל הַתְּשׁוּעוֹת וְעַל הַנִּפְלָאוֹת שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם בִּזְּמַן הַזֶּה:

segs.text: בִּימֵי מַתִּתְיָהו בֶּן יוֹחָנָן כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל, חַשְׁמוֹנָאִי וּבָנָיו, כְּשֶׁעָמְדָה מַלְכוּת יָוָן הָרְשָׁעָה עַל עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְהַשְׁכִּיחָם תּוֹרָתֶךָ וּלְהַעֲבִירָם מֵחֻקֵּי רְצוֹנֶךָ, וְאַתָּה בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים, עָמַדְתָּ לָהֶם בְּעֵת צָרָתָם. רַבְתָּ אֶת־רִיבָם, דַּנְתָּ אֶת־דִּינָם, נָקַמְתָּ אֶת־נִקְמָתָם, מָסַרְתָּ גִבּוֹרִים בְּיַד חַלָּשִׁים, וְרַבִּים בְּיַד מְעַטִּים, וּטְמֵאִים בְּיַד טְהוֹרִים, וּרְשָׁעִים בְּיַד צַדִּיקִים, וְזֵדִים בְּיַד עוֹסְקֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ. וּלְךָ עָשִׂיתָ שֵׁם גָּדוֹל וְקָדוֹשׁ בְּעוֹלָמֶךָ, וּלְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל עָשִׂיתָ תְּשׁוּעָה גְדוֹלָה וּפֻרְקָן כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה. וְאַחַר כָּךְ בָּאוּ בָנֶיךָ לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶךָ, וּפִנּוּ אֶת הֵיכָלֶךָ, וְטִהֲרוּ אֶת־מִקְדָּשֶׁךָ, וְהִדְלִיקוּ נֵרוֹת בְּחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְקָבְעוּ שְׁמוֹנַת יְמֵי חֲנֻכָּה אֵלּוּ, לְהוֹדוֹת וּלְהַלֵּל לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל:
וְעַל־כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרֵךְ וְיִתְרוֹמָם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
וְכָל־הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל לְעוֹלָם כִּי טוֹב, הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה, הָאֵל הַטּוֹב. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:

שִׂים שָׁלוֹם, טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חַיִּים חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ, כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד, וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם, וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם:
יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:

אֱלֹהַי, נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע, וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה, וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה. פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ תִּרְדּוֹף נַפְשִׁי, וְכָל־הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם: יִהְיוּ כְּמֹץ לִפְנֵי רוּחַ וּמַלְאַךְ יְיָ דּוֹחֶה. לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ, הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי: עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ. יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:

parts.text: שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל,

segs.text: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁיִבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ:

segs.en: The chazzan says Kaddish Shalem.
segs.text: <small>הש״ץ אומר קדיש שלם</small>

parts.text: בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא.

segs.text: תִּתְקַבֵּל צְלוֹתְהוֹן וּבָעוּתְהוֹן דְּכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, קֳדָם אֲבוּהוֹן דִּי בִשְׁמַיָּא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּֽא מִן־שְׁמַיָּֽא וְחַיִּֽים טוֹבִֽים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן:

parts.en: During the Ten Days of Repentance:

parts.text: בִּמְרוֹמָֽיו הוּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה שָׁלֽוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל וְאִמְרֽוּ אָמֵֽן:

segs.text: Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
Hashem, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

Blessed are You, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; the great, mighty and awesome God, God Most High, Who bestows lovingkindnesses, Who is Master of all, Who remembers the kindnesses of the fathers, and brings a redeemer to their children's children for the sake of His Name, with love. O King, Helper, Savior and Shield. Blessed are You, Hashem, Shield of Abraham.
You are mighty forever, Hashem; You revive the dead, You are great in saving.

parts.text: Who causes the dew to fall.
Who causes the wind to blow and the rain to fall.

segs.text: Who sustains the living with kindness, revives the dead with abundant mercy, supports the fallen, heals the sick, releases the bound, and keeps His faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like You, Master of mighty deeds, and who resembles You, O King, Who causes death and gives life and brings forth salvation? And You are faithful to revive the dead. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who revives the dead.

A crown shall they give You, Hashem our God, the angels, the multitudes on high, together with Your people Israel, gathered below. Together all of them shall recite a threefold Kedushah to You, as it is written by Your prophet: And one called to another and said: “Holy, holy, holy is Hashem of hosts; the whole earth is full of His glory.” Facing them they praise and say: “Blessed is the glory of Hashem from His place.” And in Your holy words it is written: “Hashem shall reign forever, your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Praise Hashem!”
You are holy and Your Name is holy, and the holy ones praise You every day, Selah. Blessed are You, Hashem, the holy God.

You gave Your people the heads of the months, a time of atonement for all their descendants. When they would bring before You offerings of favor and sin-goats to atone for them, it would be a remembrance for all of them, and a deliverance of their souls from the hand of the enemy. A new altar may You establish in Zion, and upon it we shall offer the burnt offering of Rosh Chodesh. We shall prepare he-goats with favor, and in the service of the Holy Temple we shall all rejoice. And in the songs of David Your servant, heard in Your city and recited before Your altar, may You bring them everlasting love, and remember the covenant of the fathers for the children. And bring us to Zion Your city with song, and to Jerusalem, the house of Your Sanctuary, with everlasting joy; and there we shall prepare before You the offerings of our obligations, the daily offerings in their order and the additional offerings according to their law. And the additional offering of this day of Rosh Chodesh we shall prepare and offer before You with love, according to the commandment of Your will, as You have written for us in Your Torah, through Moses Your servant, from Your glorious mouth, as it is said:
“And on your new moons you shall offer a burnt offering to Hashem: two young bulls, one ram, seven lambs in their first year, without blemish.”

Their meal offerings and libations as prescribed: three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the ram, one tenth for each lamb, and wine for its libation, and a he-goat for atonement, and two daily offerings according to their law.

Our God and God of our fathers, renew for us this month for good and for blessing, for joy and for gladness, for salvation and for consolation, for sustenance and for support, for good life and for peace, for pardon of sin and forgiveness of iniquity. For You have chosen Your people Israel from among all the nations, and You have established for them the laws of the heads of the months. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who sanctifies Israel and the heads of the months.

Be pleased, Hashem our God, with Your people Israel and their prayer; restore the service to the Sanctuary of Your House, and accept the fire offerings of Israel and their prayer with love and favor, and may the service of Your people Israel always be pleasing to You. And may our eyes behold Your return to Zion in mercy. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who restores His Presence to Zion.

We thank You, for You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers forever and ever; Rock of our lives, Shield of our salvation, You are the same from generation to generation. We will thank You and recount Your praise for our lives, which are committed into Your hand, and for our souls, which are in Your charge, and for Your miracles that are with us every day, and for Your wonders and favors at all times, evening, morning and afternoon. The Beneficent One, for Your mercies never end; the Merciful One, for Your kindnesses never cease; for we have always placed our hope in You.

We thank You, for You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers, God of all flesh, our Creator, Creator of the beginning. Blessings and thanksgivings to Your great and holy Name for having kept us alive and sustained us. So may You keep us alive and sustain us, and gather our exiles to the courtyards of Your holiness, that we may return to You to keep Your laws and do Your will and serve You with a whole heart, for which we thank You. Blessed is the God of thanksgivings.
[We thank You also] for the miracles, for the redemption, for the mighty deeds, for the saving acts and for the wonders that You performed for our ancestors in those days, at this time.

In the days of Mattityahu, son of Yochanan the High Priest, the Hasmonean, and his sons, when the wicked Greek kingdom rose up against Your people Israel to make them forget Your Torah and to turn them away from the statutes of Your will, You, in Your abundant mercy, stood by them in their time of distress. You waged their battle, You judged their claim, You avenged their wrong. You delivered the strong into the hands of the weak, the many into the hands of the few, the impure into the hands of the pure, the wicked into the hands of the righteous, and the willful sinners into the hands of those who occupy themselves with Your Torah. You made a great and holy name for Yourself in Your world, and for Your people Israel You performed a great salvation and redemption to this very day. Afterward Your children came to the sanctuary of Your House, cleansed Your Temple, purified Your Sanctuary, kindled lights in Your holy courtyards, and established these eight days of Chanukah to give thanks and praise to Your great name.
And for all of them, may Your Name, our King, be blessed, exalted and extolled continually, forever and ever.

And all that live will thank You, Selah, and will praise Your great Name forever, for it is good; God of our salvation and our help, Selah, the good God. Blessed are You, Hashem, Whose Name is the Good, and to Whom it is fitting to give thanks.

Our God and God of our fathers, bless us with the threefold blessing in the Torah, written by the hand of Moses Your servant, spoken from the mouth of Aaron and his sons, the priests, Your holy people, as it is said: “May Hashem bless you and guard you.” Amen. “May Hashem make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you.” Amen. “May Hashem lift up His face to you and grant you peace.” Amen.

Grant peace, goodness and blessing, life, grace, kindness and mercy upon us and upon all Israel Your people. Bless us, our Father, all of us as one, with the light of Your countenance, for with the light of Your countenance You have given us, Hashem our God, a Torah of life and love of kindness, righteousness, blessing, mercy, life and peace. And may it be good in Your eyes to bless Your people Israel at all times and in every hour with Your peace. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who blesses His people Israel with peace.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Hashem, my Rock and my Redeemer.

My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit. To those who curse me, let my soul be silent, and let my soul be like dust to all. Open my heart to Your Torah, and let my soul pursue Your commandments. As for all who plot evil against me, quickly nullify their counsel and frustrate their designs. May they be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of Hashem driving them on. That Your beloved ones may be rescued, save with Your right hand and answer me. Act for the sake of Your Name; act for the sake of Your right hand; act for the sake of Your Torah; act for the sake of Your holiness. May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Hashem, my Rock and my Redeemer.
He Who makes peace in His heights, may He make peace for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that the Holy Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our portion in Your Torah.

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
May the prayers and supplications of all Israel be accepted before their Father in heaven; and say: Amen.
May there be abundant peace from heaven, and good life, for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.

parts.text: in His heights, may He make peace for us and for all Israel; and say: Amen.
בְּעָלְמָֽא דִּי בְרָֽא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִֽיךְ מַלְכוּתֵֽהּ,
יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּֽא מְבָרַֽךְ לְעָלַֽם וּלְעָלְמֵֽי עָלְמַיָּֽא.

segs.text: אֲדֹנָי, שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח, וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ:

בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, אֱלֹהֵֽי אַבְרָהָֽם, אֱלֹהֵֽי יִצְחָֽק, וֵאלֹהֵֽי יַעֲקֹֽב, הָאֵֽל הַגָּדֽוֹל הַגִּבּֽוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָֽא, אֵל עֶלְיֽוֹן, גּוֹמֵֽל חֲסָדִֽים טוֹבִֽים, קוֹנֵֽה הַכֹּֽל, וְזוֹכֵֽר חַסְדֵּֽי אָבֽוֹת, וּמֵבִֽיא גּוֹאֵֽל לִבְנֵֽי בְנֵיהֶֽם לְמַֽעַן שְׁמוֹ בְּאַהֲבָֽה: מֶֽלֶךְ עוֹזֵֽר וּמוֹשִֽׁיעַ וּמָגֵֽן: בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, מָגֵֽן אַבְרָהָֽם:
אַתָּֽה גִּבּֽוֹר לְעוֹלָֽם אֲדֹנָֽי, מְחַיֶּֽה מֵתִֽים אַתָּֽה, רַב לְהוֹשִֽׁיעַ:

parts.en: Who causes the dew to fall.
Who causes the wind to blow and the rain to fall.

segs.text: מְכַלְכֵּֽל חַיִּֽים בְּחֶֽסֶד, מְחַיֶּֽה מֵתִֽים בְּרַחֲמִֽים רַבִּֽים, סוֹמֵֽךְ נוֹפְלִֽים, וְרוֹפֵֽא חוֹלִֽים, וּמַתִּֽיר אֲסוּרִֽים, וּמְקַיֵּֽם אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ לִישֵׁנֵֽי עָפָֽר. מִי־כָמֽוֹךָ בַּֽעַל גְּבוּרֽוֹת וּמִֽי דּֽוֹמֶה לָּךְ, מֶֽלֶךְ מֵמִֽית וּמְחַיֶּֽה וּמַצְמִֽיחַ יְשׁוּעָֽה: וְנֶאֱמָֽן אַתָּֽה לְהַחֲיוֹֽת מֵתִֽים. בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, מְחַיֶּֽה הַמֵּתִֽים:

parts.en: When the chazzan repeats the Amidah, the congregation says this:

parts.text: כֶּֽתֶר יִתְּנוּ לְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מַלְאָכִים הֲמֽוֹנֵי מַֽעְלָה וְעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל קְבוּצֵי מַֽטָּה. יַחַד כֻּלָּם קְדֻשָּׁה לְךָ יְשַׁלֵּֽשׁוּ, כַּכָּתֽוּב עַל־יַד נְבִיאֶֽךָ, וְקָרָֽא זֶה אֶל־זֶֽה וְאָמַֽר:
קָדֽוֹשׁ ׀ קָדֽוֹשׁ, קָדֽוֹשׁ יְיָ צְבָאֽוֹת, מְלֹא כָל־הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ:
יִמְלֹֽךְ יְיָ לְעוֹלָֽם, אֱלֹהַֽיִךְ צִיּוֹֽן לְדֹר וָדֹֽר, הַלְלוּיָֽהּ:

segs.text: אַתָּֽה קָדֽוֹשׁ וְשִׁמְךָֽ קָדֽוֹשׁ, וּקְדוֹשִֽׁים בְּכָל־יוֹֽם יְהַלְלֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה. בָּרֽוּךְ אַתָּֽה יְיָ, הָאֵֽל הַקָּדֽוֹשׁ:

אַתָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל־הָעַמִּים, אָהַֽבְתָּ אוֹתָֽנוּ וְרָצִֽיתָ בָּֽנוּ, וְרוֹמַמְתָּֽנוּ מִכָּל־הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת, וְקִדַּשְׁתָּֽנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ, וְקֵרַבְתָּֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶֽךָ וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵֽינוּ קָרָֽאתָ:
וַתִּתֶּן־לָֽנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה מוֹעֲדִים לְשִׂמְחָה, חַגִּים וּזְמַנִּים לְשָׂשׂוֹן, אֶת־יוֹם
מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ זֵֽכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָֽיִם:

וּמִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵֽינוּ גָּלִֽינוּ מֵאַרְצֵֽנוּ, וְנִתְרַחַֽקְנוּ מֵעַל אַדְמָתֵֽנוּ, וְאֵין אָנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲלוֹת וְלֵרָאוֹת וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֹת לְפָנֶֽיךָ, וְלַעֲשׂוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ בְּבֵית בְּחִירָתֶֽךָ, בַּבַּֽיִת הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ, שֶׁנִּקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלָיו, מִפְּנֵי הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה בְּמִקְדָּשֶֽׁךָ: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶֽיךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, מֶֽלֶךְ רַחֲמָן, שֶׁתָּשׁוּב וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים, וְתִבְנֵֽהוּ מְהֵרָה וּתְגַדֵּל כְּבוֹדוֹ. אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, גַּלֵּה כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ עָלֵֽינוּ מְהֵרָה, וְהוֹפַע וְהִנָּשֵׂא עָלֵֽינוּ לְעֵינֵי כָּל־חָי. וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵֽינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם וּנְפוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָֽרֶץ. וַהֲבִיאֵֽנוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירְךָ בְּרִנָּה, וְלִירוּשָׁלַֽיִם בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם, וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֶת־קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ, תְּמִידִים כְּסִדְרָם, וּמוּסָפִים כְּהִלְכָתָם.
וְאֶת מוּסַף יוֹם

הַזֶּה, וְיוֹם מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, נַעֲשֶׂה וְנַקְרִיב לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּאַהֲבָה, כְּמִצְוַת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַֽבְתָּ עָלֵֽינוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ, עַל־יְדֵי משֶׁה עַבְדֶּֽךָ, מִפִּי כְבוֹדֶֽךָ כָּאָמוּר:

segs.en: On Chol HaMoed Pesach:
segs.text: <small>בחוה״מ פסח</small>
וְהִקְרַבְתֶּם אִשֶּׁה עֹלָה לַייָ פָּרִים בְּנֵי־בָקָר שְׁנַֽיִם וְאַֽיִל אֶחָד, וְשִׁבְעָה כְבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה תְּמִימִם יִהְיוּ לָכֶם:

parts.text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר: שְׁלשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר,

parts.en: Our God and God of our fathers.

segs.en: For the first day of Chol HaMoed Sukkot:
segs.text: <small>ליום ראשון של חול המועד סוכות</small>
וּבַיּוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי, פָּרִים בְּנֵי־בָקָר שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר, אֵילִם שְׁנָֽיִם, כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר, תְּמִימִם:

parts.text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר: שְׁלשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר,

parts.en: Our God and God of our fathers.
Outside the Land of Israel, add:

segs.en: For the second day of Chol HaMoed Sukkot:
segs.text: <small>ליום שני של חול המועד סוכות</small>
וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי, פָּרִים עַשְׁתֵּי־עָשָׂר, אֵילִם שְׁנָֽיִם, כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר, תְּמִימִם:

parts.text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר: שְׁלשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר,

parts.en: Our God and God of our fathers.
Outside the Land of Israel, add:

segs.en: For the third day of Chol HaMoed Sukkot:
segs.text: <small>ליום שלישי של חול המועד סוכות</small>
וּבַיּוֹם הָרְבִיעִי, פָּרִים עֲשָׂרָה, אֵילִם שְׁנָֽיִם, כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר, תְּמִימִם:

parts.text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר: שְׁלשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר,

parts.en: Our God and God of our fathers.
Outside the Land of Israel, add:

segs.en: For the fourth day of Chol HaMoed Sukkot:
segs.text: <small>ליום רביעי של חול המועד סוכות</small>
וּבַיּוֹם הַחֲמִישִׁי, פָּרִים תִּשְׁעָה, אֵילִם שְׁנָֽיִם, כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר, תְּמִימִם:

parts.text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר: שְׁלשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר,

parts.en: Our God and God of our fathers.
Outside the Land of Israel, add:

segs.en: For the fifth day of Chol HaMoed Sukkot [in the Land of Israel]:
segs.text: <small>ליום חמישי של חול המועד סוכות [בארץ ישראל]</small>
וּבַיּוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי, פָּרִים שְׁמֹנָה, אֵילִם שְׁנָֽיִם, כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר, תְּמִימִם:

parts.text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר: שְׁלשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר,

parts.en: Our God and God of our fathers.

segs.en: For Hoshana Raba:
segs.text: <small>להושענא רבה</small>

parts.en: Outside the Land of Israel, begin:

parts.text: וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר: שְׁלשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר,

parts.en: Our God and God of our fathers.

segs.text: וּבַיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי, פָּרִים שִׁבְעָה, אֵילִם שְׁנָֽיִם, כְּבָשִׂים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָה אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר, תְּמִימִם:
וּמִנְחָתָם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶם כִּמְדֻבָּר: שְׁלשָׁה עֶשְׂרֹנִים לַפָּר, וּשְׁנֵי עֶשְׂרֹנִים לָאָֽיִל, וְעִשָּׂרוֹן לַכֶּֽבֶשׂ, וְיַֽיִן כְּנִסְכּוֹ, וְשָׂעִיר לְכַפֵּר וּשְׁנֵי תְמִידִים כְּהִלְכָתָם:

אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ רַחֲמָן רַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ, טוֹב וּמֵטִיב הִדָּֽרֶשׁ לָֽנוּ, שֽׁוּבָה עָלֵֽינוּ בַּהֲמוֹן רַחֲמֶֽיךָ, בִּגְלַל אָבוֹת שֶׁעָשׂוּ רְצוֹנֶֽךָ. בְּנֵה בֵיתְךָ כְּבַתְּחִלָּה, וְכוֹנֵן מִקְדָּשְׁךָ עַל־מְכוֹנוֹ, וְהַרְאֵֽנוּ בְּבִנְיָנוֹ וְשַׂמְּחֵֽנוּ בְּתִקּוּנוֹ. וְהָשֵׁב כֹּהֲנִים לַעֲבוֹדָתָם, וּלְוִיִּם לְשִׁירָם וּלְזִמְרָם, וְהָשֵׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל לְנָוֵיהֶם, וְשָׁם נַעֲלֶה וְנֵרָאֶה וְנִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְפָנֶֽיךָ בְּשָׁלשׁ פַּעֲמֵי רְגָלֵֽינוּ, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ: שָׁלוֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה, יֵרָאֶה כָל זְכוּרְךָ אֶת־פְּנֵי יְיָ אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ, בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחָר, בְּחַג הַמַּצּוֹת, וּבְחַג הַשָּׁבֻעוֹת, וּבְחַג הַסֻּכּוֹת, וְלֹא יֵרָאֶה אֶת־פְּנֵי יְיָ רֵיקָם: אִישׁ כְּמַתְּנַת יָדוֹ כְּבִרְכַּת יְיָ אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ אֲשֶׁר נָֽתַן־לָךְ:

וְהַשִּׂיאֵֽנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת־בִּרְכַּת מוֹעֲדֶֽיךָ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם, לְשִׂמְחָה וּלְשָׂשׂוֹן, כַּאֲשֶׁר רָצִֽיתָ וְאָמַֽרְתָּ לְבָרְכֵֽנוּ. קַדְּשֵֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ, שַׂבְּעֵֽנוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ וְשַׂמֵּחַ נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ, וְטַהֵר לִבֵּֽנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶּאֱמֶת, וְהַנְחִילֵֽנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׂשׂוֹן מוֹעֲדֵי קָדְשֶֽׁךָ, וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְךָ כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶֽךָ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַדֵּשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַזְּמַנִּים:

רְצֵה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּעַמְּךָֽ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלִתְפִלָּתָֽם שְׁעֵה, וְהָשֵֽׁב הָעֲבוֹדָֽה לִדְבִֽיר בֵּיתֶךָ, וְאִשֵּֽׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָֽם בְּאַהֲבָֽה תְקַבֵּֽל בְּרָצֽוֹן, וּתְהִֽי לְרָצֽוֹן תָּמִֽיד עֲבוֹדַֽת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ: וְתֶחֱזֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ בְּשׁוּבְךָ לְצִיּוֹן בְּרַחֲמִים. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּחֲזִיר שְׁכִינָתוֹ לְצִיּוֹן:

parts.text: לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵֽי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, צוּר חַיֵּינוּ, מָגֵן יִשְׁעֵנוּ, אַתָּה־הוּא לְדוֹר וָדוֹר, נוֹדֶה לְּךָ וּנְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ, עַל חַיֵּינוּ הַמְּסוּרִים בְּיָדֶךָ, וְעַל נִשְׁמוֹתֵינוּ הַפְּקוּדוֹת לָךְ, וְעַל נִסֶּיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־יוֹם עִמָּנוּ, וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְטוֹבוֹתֶיךָ שֶׁבְּכָל־עֵת, עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֱרָיִם. הַטּוֹב, כִּי לֹּא־כָלֽוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, הַמְרַחֵֽם, כִּי לֹא־תַֽמּוּ חֲסָדֶֽיךָ, כִּי מֵעוֹלָֽם קִוִּֽינוּ לָךְ:

מוֹדִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ לָךְ, שָׁאַתָּה הוּא יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, אֱלֹהֵי כָּל־בָּשָׂר, יוֹצְרֵֽנוּ, יוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית, בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ, עַל שֶׁהֶחֱיִיתָֽנוּ וְקִיַּמְתָּֽנוּ, כֵּן תְּחַיֵּֽינוּ וּתְקַיְּמֵֽנוּ, וְתֶאֱסוֹף גָּלֻיּוֹתֵֽינוּ לְחַצְרוֹת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ, וְנָשׁוּב אֵלֶיךָ לִשְׁמוֹר חֻקֶּֽיךָ, וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶֽךָ, וּלְעָבְדְּךָ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם, עַל שֶׁאָֽנוּ מוֹדִים לָךְ, בָּרוּךְ אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת:

segs.text: וְעַל־כֻּלָּם יִתְבָּרֵךְ וְיִתְרוֹמָם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ תָּמִיד לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
וְכָל־הַחַיִּים יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה, וִיהַלְלוּ שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל לְעוֹלָם כִּי טוֹב, הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ וְעֶזְרָתֵנוּ סֶלָה, הָאֵל הַטּוֹב. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַטּוֹב שִׁמְךָ וּלְךָ נָאֶה לְהוֹדוֹת:

שִׂים שָׁלוֹם, טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה, חַיִּים חֵן וָחֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים, עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּךָ. בָּרְכֵנוּ אָבִינוּ כֻּלָּנוּ כְּאֶחָד בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ, כִּי בְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ נָתַתָּ לָּנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ תּוֹרַת חַיִּים וְאַהֲבַת חֶסֶד, וּצְדָקָה וּבְרָכָה וְרַחֲמִים וְחַיִּים וְשָׁלוֹם, וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶךָ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּשָּׁלוֹם:
יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:

אֱלֹהַי, נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע, וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה, וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם, וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה. פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶיךָ תִּרְדּוֹף נַפְשִׁי, וְכָל־הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה, מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם: יִהְיוּ כְּמֹץ לִפְנֵי רוּחַ וּמַלְאַךְ יְיָ דּוֹחֶה. לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ, הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי: עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן יְמִינֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן תּוֹרָתֶךָ, עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ. יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:

parts.text: שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:

segs.text: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שֶׁיִבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵינוּ, וְתֵן חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ:

Magnified and sanctified be His great Name. Amen. In the world that He created according to His will; and may He establish His kingdom, and cause His redemption to sprout, and bring near His Messiah. Amen. In your lifetime and in your days and in the lifetime of all the House of Israel, speedily and soon; and say: Amen. May His great Name be blessed forever and to all eternity. Blessed, praised, glorified, exalted, extolled, honored, uplifted and lauded be the Name of the Holy One, blessed be He. Blessed is He. Amen. Beyond all the blessings and songs, praises and consolations that are uttered in the world; and say: Amen.
My Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.

Blessed are You, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; the great, mighty, and awesome God, the Supreme God, Who bestows good kindnesses and is Master of all, Who remembers the kindnesses of the fathers, and brings a redeemer to their children's children, for His Name's sake, with love. O King, Helper, Savior, and Shield. Blessed are You, Hashem, Shield of Abraham.
You are mighty forever, my Lord; You revive the dead; You are abundant in saving.

parts.text: Who causes the dew to fall.
Who causes the wind to blow and the rain to fall.

segs.text: You sustain the living with loving-kindness, and revive the dead with abundant mercy. You support the fallen, heal the sick, release the bound, and keep Your faith with those who sleep in the dust. Who is like You, Master of mighty deeds, and who can be compared to You, O King Who brings death and gives life and causes salvation to sprout? And You are faithful to revive the dead. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who revives the dead.

A crown shall be given to You, Hashem our God, by the multitudes of angels above and Your people Israel gathered below. Together all of them thrice repeat holiness to You, as it is written by Your prophet: And one called to the other and said: Holy, holy, holy is Hashem of hosts; the whole earth is full of His glory. Facing them they offer praise and say: Blessed is the glory of Hashem from His place. And in Your holy words it is written: Hashem shall reign forever; your God, O Zion, from generation to generation. Halleluyah.
You are holy and Your Name is holy, and holy ones praise You every day, Selah. Blessed are You, Hashem, the holy God.

You have chosen us from among all the peoples; You have loved us and favored us; You have exalted us above all tongues and sanctified us with Your commandments; and You have brought us near, our King, to Your service, and called us by Your great and holy Name.
And You have given us, Hashem our God, with love, appointed times for gladness, festivals and seasons for joy, the day of
this Festival of Matzot, and the day of this holy convocation, the season of our freedom,
this Festival of Sukkot, and the day of this holy convocation, the season of our rejoicing,
a holy convocation, a remembrance of the exodus from Egypt.

And because of our sins we were exiled from our land and distanced from our soil, and we are unable to ascend, to appear, and to prostrate ourselves before You, and to perform our obligations in Your chosen House, the great and holy House upon which Your Name was called, because of the hand that was sent against Your Sanctuary. May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, merciful King, that You return and have mercy upon us and upon Your Sanctuary in Your abundant mercies, and rebuild it speedily and increase its glory. Our Father, our King, our God, reveal the glory of Your kingship upon us speedily; appear and be exalted over us before the eyes of all the living. Gather our scattered ones from among the nations, and assemble our dispersed from the ends of the earth. Bring us to Zion Your city with joyful song, and to Jerusalem, the home of Your Sanctuary, with everlasting joy; and there we will perform before You the offerings of our obligations: the continual offerings in their order and the additional offerings according to their law.
And the additional offering of the day of
this Festival of Matzot,
this Festival of Sukkot,

and of this day of holy convocation, we shall make and offer before You with love, according to the commandment of Your will, as You have written for us in Your Torah, through Moses Your servant, from the mouth of Your glory, as it is said:
And you shall offer a burnt-offering, a fire-offering to Hashem: two young bulls and one ram, and seven lambs in their first year; they shall be unblemished for you.

And their meal-offerings and libations as prescribed: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for the ram, one-tenth for each lamb, wine for its libation, a goat for atonement, and two continual offerings according to their law.
And on the second day: twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year, unblemished.

And their meal-offerings and libations as prescribed: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for the ram, one-tenth for each lamb, wine for its libation, a goat for atonement, and two continual offerings according to their law.
And on the third day
And on the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year, unblemished.

And their meal-offerings and libations as prescribed: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for the ram, one-tenth for each lamb, wine for its libation, a goat for atonement, and two continual offerings according to their law.
And on the fourth day
And on the fourth day: ten bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year, unblemished.

And their meal-offerings and libations as prescribed: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for the ram, one-tenth for each lamb, wine for its libation, a goat for atonement, and two continual offerings according to their law.
And on the fifth day
And on the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year, unblemished.

And their meal-offerings and libations as prescribed: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for the ram, one-tenth for each lamb, wine for its libation, a goat for atonement, and two continual offerings according to their law.
And on the sixth day
And on the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year, unblemished.

And their meal-offerings and libations as prescribed: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for the ram, one-tenth for each lamb, wine for its libation, a goat for atonement, and two continual offerings according to their law.
And on the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year, unblemished.

And their meal-offerings and libations as prescribed: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for the ram, one-tenth for each lamb, wine for its libation, a goat for atonement, and two continual offerings according to their law.
And on the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen lambs in their first year, unblemished.

And their meal-offerings and libations as prescribed: three-tenths for each bull, two-tenths for the ram, one-tenth for each lamb, wine for its libation, a goat for atonement, and two continual offerings according to their law.

Our God and God of our fathers, merciful King, have mercy upon us; Good One Who does good, let Yourself be sought by us; return to us in the abundance of Your mercies, for the sake of the fathers who did Your will. Rebuild Your House as at first, and establish Your Sanctuary on its foundation; show us its rebuilding and gladden us with its restoration. Return the kohanim to their service, and the levites to their song and music, and return Israel to their dwellings. And there we will ascend, appear, and prostrate ourselves before You on our three pilgrimage festivals, as it is written in Your Torah: Three times a year all your males shall appear before Hashem your God in the place that He will choose: on the Festival of Matzot, on the Festival of Shavuot, and on the Festival of Sukkot; and they shall not appear before Hashem empty-handed: each man according to the gift of his hand, according to the blessing of Hashem your God which He has given you.

Bestow upon us, Hashem our God, the blessing of Your festivals for good life and for peace, for gladness and for joy, as You desired and promised to bless us. Sanctify us with Your commandments and grant us our portion in Your Torah; satisfy us from Your goodness and gladden our soul with Your salvation; purify our hearts to serve You in truth; and cause us to inherit, Hashem our God, with gladness and with joy, Your holy festivals; and may all Israel, who sanctify Your Name, rejoice in You. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who sanctifies Israel and the festive seasons.

Be pleased, Hashem our God, with Your people Israel and heed their prayer; restore the service to the Sanctuary of Your House, and receive in love and favor the fire-offerings of Israel and their prayer; and may the service of Your people Israel always be pleasing to You. And may our eyes behold Your return to Zion in mercy. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who restores His Presence to Zion.

We thank You, for You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers forever and ever; Rock of our lives, Shield of our salvation, You are He from generation to generation. We will thank You and recount Your praise for our lives which are committed into Your hand, and for our souls which are entrusted to You, and for Your miracles which are with us every day, and for Your wonders and Your goodnesses which are at every time, evening, morning, and afternoon. The Beneficent One, for Your mercies never end; the Merciful One, for Your kindnesses never cease; for we have always placed our hope in You.

We thank You, for You are Hashem our God and God of our fathers, God of all flesh, our Creator, Creator of the beginning. Blessings and thanksgivings to Your great and holy Name for having kept us alive and sustained us; so may You continue to keep us alive and sustain us, and gather our exiles to the courtyards of Your Sanctuary, that we may return to You to observe Your statutes, to do Your will, and to serve You with a whole heart, for this we thank You. Blessed is the God of thanksgivings.
And for all of them, may Your Name, our King, be blessed, exalted, and raised up continually, forever and ever.

And all the living will thank You, Selah, and praise Your great Name forever, for You are good; the God of our salvation and our help, Selah, the good God. Blessed are You, Hashem, the Good is Your Name, and to You it is fitting to give thanks.

Our God and God of our fathers, bless us with the threefold blessing in the Torah, written by the hand of Moses Your servant, spoken from the mouth of Aaron and his sons, the kohanim, Your holy people, as it is said: May Hashem bless you and guard you. Amen. May Hashem make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you. Amen. May Hashem lift up His face to you and grant you peace. Amen.

Grant peace, goodness and blessing, life, grace, kindness and mercy, upon us and upon all Israel Your people. Bless us, our Father, all of us as one, with the light of Your countenance; for with the light of Your countenance You gave us, Hashem our God, the Torah of life and the love of kindness, righteousness, blessing, mercy, life, and peace. And may it be good in Your eyes to bless Your people Israel at every time and at every hour with Your peace. Blessed are You, Hashem, Who blesses His people Israel with peace.
May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Hashem, my Rock and my Redeemer.

My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceit; and to those who curse me, let my soul be silent, and let my soul be like dust to all. Open my heart to Your Torah, and let my soul pursue Your commandments. As for all those who plan evil against me, quickly annul their counsel and frustrate their design. Let them be as chaff before the wind, with the angel of Hashem driving them on. So that Your beloved ones may be delivered, save with Your right hand and answer me. Act for the sake of Your Name; act for the sake of Your right hand; act for the sake of Your Torah; act for the sake of Your holiness. May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before You, Hashem, my Rock and my Redeemer.
He Who makes peace in His heights, may He make peace for us and for all Israel, and say: Amen.
May it be Your will, Hashem our God and God of our fathers, that the Holy Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our portion in Your Torah.

segs.en: It is explained in the Talmud and codes that annulment applies only to vows and oaths concerning oneself (e.g., eating or sleeping). Vows made to others or to any person of any nation/religion cannot be annulled.
segs.text: <small>מבואר בגמרא ובפוסקים שאין שייך שאלה היתר והפרה רק לנדרים ושבועות שאדם נודר או נשבע במה שנוגע לעצמו בלבד כגון אוכל או לא אוכל אישן או לא אישן וכדומה אבל במה שנודר או נשבע לחבירו או לשום מי שמשביעו יהיה מאיזה עם ודת שיהיה אין מועיל שום היתר והפרה ושאלה בעולם:</small>

segs.en: On Erev Rosh Hashanah before midnight. It is best to have a complete court of three:
segs.text: <small>בערב ראש השנה קודם חצות. וטוב שיהא עדה שלמה:</small>

שִׁמְעוּ נָא רַבּוֹתַי דַּיָּנִים מֻמְחִים, כָּל־נֵדֶר אוֹ שְׁבוּעָה אוֹ אִסּוּר וַאֲפִילּוּ אִסּוּר הֲנָאָה שֶׁאָסַרְתִּי עָלַי אוֹ עַל־אֲחֵֽרִים בְּכָל־לָשׁוֹן שֶׁל אִסּוּר, וְכָל־מוֹצָא שְׂפָתַי שֶׁיָּצָא מִפִּי, אוֹ שֶׁנָּדַרְתִּי וְגָמַרְתִּי בְלִבִּי אֲפִילּוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת אֵיזוֹ מִצְוָה אוֹ אֵיזוֹ הַנְהָגָה טוֹבָה שֶׁנָּהַגְתִּי שְׁלשָׁה פְּעָמִים, וְלֹא הִתְנֵיתִי שֶׁיְהֵא בְּלִי נֶדֶר. הֵן דָּבָר שֶׁעָשִׂיתִי עַל עַצְמִי אוֹ עַל אֲחֵרִים, הֵן אוֹתָם הַיְדוּעִים לִי אוֹ שֶׁכְּבָר נִשְׁכְּחוּ מִמֶּנִּי, בְּכוּלְּהוֹן אִתְחֲרַטְנָא בְהוֹן מֵעִקָּרָא: וְשׁוֹאֵל וּמְבַקֵּשׁ אֲנִי הַתָּרָה עֲלֵיהֶם: וְאֵין אֲנִי תוֹהֵא חַס וְשָׁלוֹם עַל קִיּוּם מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים שֶׁעָשִׂיתִי, רַק אֲנִי מִתְחָרֵט עַל שֶׁלֹּא אָמַרְתִּי בְּפֵרוּשׁ הִנְנִי אֶעֱשֶׂה דָבָר זֶה בְּלִי נֶדֶר וּשְׁבוּעָה וְקַבָּלָה בְלֵב. לָכֵן אֲנִי שׁוֹאֵל מִמַּעֲלַתְכֶם הַתָּרָה. בְכֻלְּהוֹן אֲנִי מִתְחָרֵט עַל כָּל־הַנִּזְכָּר, בֵּין אִם הָיוּ מַעֲשִׂים הַנּוֹגְעִים בְּגוּף אוֹ בִנְּשָׁמָה אוֹ בְמָמוֹן: וְהִנֵּה מִצַּד הַדִּין, הַמִּתְחָרֵט וּמְבַקֵּשׁ הַתָּרָה צָרִיךְ לִפְרוֹט הַנֶּדֶר, אַךְ דְּעוּ נָא רַבּוֹתַי כִּי רַבִּים הֵם וְאִי אֶפְשָׁר לְפוֹרְטָם. וְאֵין אֲנִי מְבַקֵּשׁ הַתָּרָה עַל אוֹתָם הַנְּדָרִים שֶׁאֵין לְהַתִּיר אוֹתָם, עַל כֵּן יִהְיוּ נָא בְעֵינֵיכֶם כְּאִלּוּ הָיִיתִי פוֹרְטָם:

segs.en: And the annulment judges answer him three times in this language:
segs.text: <small>והמתירים משיבים לו ג״פ בלשון זה:</small>

הַכֹּל יִהְיוּ מֻתָּרִים לָךְ, הַכֹּל מְחוּלִים לָךְ, הַכֹּל שְׁרוּיִם לָךְ. אֵין כַּאן לֹא נֵדֶר, וְלֹא שְׁבוּעָה, וְלֹא אִסּוּר, וְלֹא הַסְכָּמָה וְקַבָּלָה בְלֵב. אֲבָל יֶשׁ כַּאן מְחִילָה וּסְלִיחָה וְכַפָּרָה. וּכְשֵׁם שֶׁמַּתִּירִים אֲנַחְנוּ בְּבֵית דִּין שֶׁל מַטָּה, כַּךְ יִהְיוּ מֻתָּרִים בְּבֵית דִּין שֶׁל מַעְלָה:

segs.en: And then he declares a notice before them and says in this language:
segs.text: <small>ואחר כך מוסר מודעה לפניהם ואומר בלשון הזה:</small>

הֲרֵי אֲנִי מוֹסֵר מוֹדָעָה לִפְנֵיכֶם, וַאֲנִי מְבַטֵּל מִכַּאן וּלְהַבָּא כָּל־הַנְּדָּרִים, וְכָל־הַשְּׁבוּעוֹת וְאִסּוּרִין וְהַסְכָּמוֹת וְקַבָּלוֹת בְּלֵב שֶׁאֲקַבֵּל עָלַי בְּעַצְמִי, חוּץ מִנִּדְרֵי תַעֲנִית בִּשְׁעַת מִנְחָה. וּבְאִם שֶׁאֶשְׁכַּח תְּנַאי מוֹדָעָה הַזֹּאת וְאֶדּוֹר מֵהַיּוֹם עוֹד, מֵעַתָּה אֲנִי מִתְחָרֵט עֲלֵיהֶם וּמַתְנֶה עֲלֵיהֶם שֶׁיִּהְיוּ כֻּלָּן בְּטֵלִין וּמְבֻטָּלִין, לָא שְׁרִירִין וְלָא קַיָּמִין, וְלָא יְהוֹן חָלִין כְּלָל וּכְלָל, בְכֻלְּהוֹן אִתְחֲרַטְנָא בְהוֹן מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:

segs.en: And the annulment judges answer him:
segs.text: <small>והמתירים משיבים לו:</small>

כֻּלָּם יִהְיוּ מֻתָּרִים לָךְ, כֻּלָּם יִהְיוּ מְחוּלִים לָךְ, כֻּלָּם יִהְיוּ שְׁרוּיִם לָךְ. אֵין כַּאן לֹא נִדּוּי וְלֹא שַׁמְתָּא וְלֹא אָרוּר. אֲבָל יֵשׁ כַּאן מְחִילָה וּסְלִיחָה וְכַפָּרָה. וּכְשֵׁם שֶׁמֻּתָּר אַתָּה מִבֵּית דִּין שֶׁל מַטָּה, כַּךְ תְּהֵא מֻתָּר מִבֵּית דִּין שֶׁל מַעְלָה וְלֹא יַעֲשֶׂה שׁוּם רֹשָׁם כְּלָל וְכָל־הַקְּלָלוֹת יֵהָפְכוּ לִבְרָכָה כְּדִכְתִיב וַיַּהֲפֹךְ יְיָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ לְּךָ אֶת־הַקְּלָלָה לִבְרָכָה כִּי אֲהֵבְךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֶיךָ:

Hear now, my masters, expert judges: Every vow, oath, or prohibition, even a prohibition of benefit, that I have forbidden upon myself or upon others, in any language of prohibition, and every utterance of my lips that has issued from my mouth, or that I have vowed and resolved in my heart, even to do some mitzvah or some good practice that I have followed three times and did not stipulate that it be without a vow: whether it is a thing that I did for myself or for others, whether those that are known to me or those that have already been forgotten by me, I regret them all, from the outset; and I ask and request annulment of them. And I am not, Heaven forbid, regretting the fulfillment of the good deeds I have done; rather, I regret that I did not say explicitly: “I will do this thing without a vow or an oath or an acceptance in the heart.” Therefore I ask annulment of you, esteemed ones. I regret all that was mentioned, whether they were matters concerning the body, the soul, or money. Now, by the law, one who regrets and asks for annulment must specify the vow; but know, my masters, that they are many and it is impossible to specify them. And I do not ask annulment for those vows that cannot be annulled. Therefore, let it be in your eyes as if I had specified them.

All of them shall be permitted to you, all forgiven to you, all released to you. There is here no vow, no oath, no prohibition, and no resolve or acceptance in the heart. But there is here pardon, forgiveness, and atonement. And just as we release below in the earthly court, so shall they be released in the court above.

Behold, I give notice before you that from now onward I cancel all vows, oaths, prohibitions, resolves, and acceptances in the heart that I may take upon myself, except for vows of fasting at the time of Mincha. And if I forget the condition of this notice and vow from today onward, from now I regret them and stipulate concerning them that they all shall be null and void, not binding and not in force, and shall have no effect at all; I regret them all, from now and forever.

May all of them be permitted to you, may all of them be forgiven to you, may all of them be released to you. There is here no excommunication, no ban, and no curse. But there is here pardon, forgiveness, and atonement.
